content:
I do observe plain text multi-line signatures being previewed on only one line The signature is displaying correctly for me within the edit box and during email compositions. I didn't experience any issue adding carriage returns.

Version 24 added support for HTML signatures. https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/releases/tag/THUNDERBIRD_24_0

It seems like the preview is always treating text in the signature edit box as HTML. It doesn't seem to render a plain text preview when the HTML signature checkbox is disabled.

The carriage returns are correctly displayed when HTML line break tags are entered. See screen shots
